## What topic or feature are you requesting?

<!-- Be specific. "Add a case study for designing a rate limiter" is actionable. "Add more content" is not. -->

## What problem does this solve for learners?

<!-- Why is this topic valuable? What gap does it fill? Who would benefit from it? -->

## Proposed solution

<!-- How should this be covered? What should the content include? If it's a case study, list the key design decisions you'd expect to see addressed. -->

## Alternatives you've considered

<!-- Have you found other resources that cover this? What do they do well or poorly? -->

## Would you like to write this yourself?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to claim this and write the content
- [ ] No, I'm requesting it for someone else to pick up

## Additional context

<!-- Any reference material, diagrams, or links that would be useful as a starting point. -->
